en: A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a woman in a long dark evening gown decorated with vertical sparkling stripes and a long necklace. She stands on an ornate patterned carpet and holds back a richly patterned curtain. The setting is a painted studio backdrop suggesting a balcony and landscape. In the lower left corner, small printed text identifies the subject and role.
